concept_attempts.feedback: Selected: asymmetric mineral mass, brass front S and right return, exactly three unequal blue insets and one lower red terminal. Concept conduit is thicker than original; GLB must keep a slender seated line. Exact route/socket engineering and microrelief authored.

issues: Three blue nodes, lower red terminal and thin S conduit are correctly placed.
Body is too narrow and regular versus source: widen it, strengthen right shoulder/asymmetric summit.
Add restrained dirty-red material variation so the terminal is worn hardware rather than a clean flat UI button.

final_review: Final independent GLB retains the broad asymmetric ore mass, three unequal blue insets, one lower red terminal and thin seated brass S conduit with a right shoulder return segment. Actual feedback widens the mass, strengthens the right shoulder and varies the red terminal material. The thinner conduit follows legacy over the heavier concept pipe.
limitations: Exact sections, socket details, conduit material/joints and hidden routing are authored; no robot production mechanism is visible in original references.
Portable worn materials, sparse chips and broken veins are authored rather than copied from legacy pixels. Not every concept microcrevice is represented.
No source metric height, calibrated client scale/state, Android performance or final user artistic acceptance claimed.
